verses.ar:
يَا طَيْبَةْ، يَا طَيْبَةْ
يَا دَوَا الْعَيَانَا
اِشْتَقْنَا لَكَ
وَالْهَوَى نَادَانَا (2)
verses.tr:
Yā Ṭaybah, yā Ṭaybah
Yā dawā-l-ʿayānā
Ishtaqnā lak
Wa-l-hawā nādānā (2)
verses.en: O Taybah, O Taybah, O cure of our eyes — we have longed for you, and love itself has called us to you.

verses.ar:
يَا عَلِيُّ ابْنَ أَبِي طَالِبْ
مِنْكُمُ مَصْدَرُ الْمَوَاهِبْ
هَلْ تُرَى هَلْ أُرَى لِي حَاجِبْ
عِنْدَكُمْ
أَفْضَلُ الْغِلْمَانَا
أَفْضَلُ الْغِلْمَانَا
verses.tr:
Yā ʿAlī-ibna Abī Ṭālib
Minkumu maṣdaru-l-mawāhib
Hal turā hal urā lī ḥājib
ʿIndakum
Afḍalu-l-ghilmānā
Afḍalu-l-ghilmānā
verses.en: O Ali, son of Abu Talib, from you comes the very source of every gift — is there, I wonder, any veil between us? With you are the finest of young men, the finest of young men.

verses.ar:
أَسْيَادِي الْحَسَنُ وَالْحُسَيْنِ
إِلَى النَّبِيِّ قُرَّةُ عَيْنِي
وَيَا شَبَابَ الْجَنَّتَيْنِ
جَدُّكُمْ
صَاحِبُ الْقُرْآنَ
صَاحِبُ الْقُرْآنَ
verses.tr:
Asyādī-l-Ḥasanu wa-l-Ḥusayn
Ila-n-Nabiyyi qurratu ʿaynī
Wa yā shabāba-l-jannatayn
Jaddukum
Ṣāḥibu-l-Qurʾān
Ṣāḥibu-l-Qurʾān
verses.en: Our masters, Hasan and Husayn, are the coolness of the Prophet's eyes; O youths of the two gardens of Paradise, your grandfather is the master of the Qur'an, the master of the Qur'an.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon him and his family.
